items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: From records, all that was learned from records you know. Junior Walker and the All-Stars

ctx.x: Do you remember learning — how did you learn your parts?

From records. From records, all that was learned from records you know. Junior Walker and the All-Stars — who else were we doing — we did, well at that time Mercy, Mercy came out, the Cannonball Adderley group came out. We did the Motown stuff. I listened to the parts you know. I knew the melodies and you would listen to them, you knew the rhythms, how the rhythm section worked, and you just learned those things. You could sing all the parts. You know?
You can’t beat that. That’s the best ear training.
